valid.description: Indicates whether the verified token is valid and active

user_id.description: Platform internal auto-increment primary key ID

user_uuid.description: Stable UUID v4 identifier for cross-service events and API contracts

role.description: Primary role assigned to the user, or null if none

supplier_id.description: Associated supplier code for supplier role users, else null

is_active.description: Whether the user account is active

permissions.description: Fine-grained permissions granted to the user based on role
